column3: *Gist:* The year-wheel, undecaying, revolves; ten (five world-guardians and five classes of men) bear it; the sun's orb, invested with water, moves; all beings rest in it.
column4: (no counterpart; the Kannada has no gist after the Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)
column5: An English summary of the verse is inserted that the Kannada does not contain.
